what: fleet fingerprint does not lead hashrate
why: deployment shows up in hashrate and nonce pattern simultaneously; epoch granularity too coarse to see ramp
new_hypotheses: H011: daily-resolution fingerprint ramp vs daily hashrate (needs finer bins, ~144 blocks/day -> noisy)

what: price momentum adds nothing to difficulty forecast
why: hashrate supply response to price operates over months (ASIC lead times); 2-week epoch horizon too short; outliers dominate linear corr
lesson: epoch-horizon hashrate change is mostly supply-side, not price-side
new_hypotheses: H012: hashprice (price*reward/difficulty) below production-cost threshold -> hashrate DROP next epoch (nonlinear, needs cost curve data)
